company.name: Replay
company.shortDescription: Replay is a browser that records all of the context you need to fix bugs faster.
company.description:
Replay is a browser that records all of the contexts needed to fix bugs faster. It enables team members to jump to any point in the execution, add Console logs on the fly, and squash bugs.

It was founded in 2021 and is based in San Francisco, California.

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based debugging tool that records and replays web app sessions to identify and analyze bugs.

productsAndServices.description: A no-code chat API tool that records app behavior and uses AI to analyze and explain root causes of bugs.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $13,000,002, or 69.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,161,897 to $61,825,066, a 2.67x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
